title: The Pilgrimage of the Rustling Oaks
summary: Travel to the sacred oracle sanctuary to decipher the whispering omens of the Pelasgian oak.

approach_sanctuary.description: Ascend the mountain path toward the sanctuary.

seek_omens.description: Speak with the head priestess and interpret the sacred bronze cauldrons.

objectives.text: Decipher the inscription upon the tripod.

completed.description: The sacred omens have been received and recorded in your journal.
